gloss: as before; as usual; as has been the case

definitions.gloss: as before; as usual; in the same way as before
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something continues in the same manner as it has been done previously. Used to state that no change has been or will be made.

examples.japanese: {営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}は{従来通|じゅうらいどお}りです。
examples.english: Business hours remain the same as before.

examples.japanese: {従来通|じゅうらいどお}りの{方法|ほうほう}で{進|すす}めましょう。
examples.english: Let's proceed in the same way as before.

examples.japanese: {制度|せいど}が{変|か}わっても、{手続|てつづ}きは{従来通|じゅうらいどお}りで{変更|へんこう}はありません。
examples.english: Even though the system has changed, the procedures remain the same as before with no modifications.

notes:
FORMATION:
{従来|じゅうらい} (conventional, traditional, up to now) + {通|どお}り (as, in accordance with). The suffix ～{通|どお}り attaches to nouns to mean "in the same way as."

GRAMMAR:
Functions as an adverb or as a noun modifier with の: {従来通|じゅうらいどお}りの{方法|ほうほう} (the same method as before).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {従来通|じゅうらいどお}りの{対応|たいおう} (the same response as before)
- {従来通|じゅうらいどお}り{変|か}わらない (remains unchanged)

NUANCE:
Common in business, administrative, and formal contexts. Often used in announcements to clarify that something has not changed despite other changes.
